messages.subject: Quick dsims question
parts:
Hi all

Hopefully a very basic question for someone - how can I view/generate medians for dsims abundance estimates? I have generated 500-1000 simulated replicates for each survey design and note median doesn't appear in the Summary Estimates of Abundance output.

Thanks in advance!

Stace

messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Quick dsims question
parts:
Stace

The median abundance estimate is not produced by the summary()​ function.  However, all replicate abundance estimates are available to you in the object created by run.simulation()​.  You can apply the median function upon a portion of that object, like this.

Code below taken from the example code associated with make.simulation()​:
simulation <- make.simulation(reps = 100,
                              design = design,
                              population.description = popdsc,
                              detectability = detect,
                              ds.analysis = ds.analyses)
simulation <- run.simulation(simulation)
median(simulation@results$individuals$N[1,1,1:100])
[1] 197.8998

The trick is knowing where inside the object to find the abundance estimates:

> str(simulation@results$individuals$N)
 num [1, 1:6, 1:102] 168.206 35.579 0.212 109.577 258.205 ...
 - attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 3
  ..$ : chr "region"
  ..$ : chr [1:6] "Estimate" "se" "cv" "lcl" ...
  ..$ : chr [1:102] "1" "2" "3" "4" ...

Hope that's helpful.
